messages:
maria: Postmortem is up. We need tidy follow-ups: runbook triage steps, explicit escalation timeline, and autoscaler remediation. Please claim ownership and short ETA.

alex.m: I'll own autoscaler tuning. Plan: sweep maxReplicas and queue-based triggers, add a model-fallback when queue_depth > 500. ETA: 2026-04-04. Will open a draft PR with perf runs.

jordan: I'll write the runbook triage edits. Adding a 5-min checklist, exact commands for control-plane+worker checks, and a "pass/fail" expected outputs section. ETA: 2026-03-31.

sam: dropping the commands that should be copied verbatim into the runbook under "node + queue health":

# control-plane
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-router -c router --since=15m | grep -i "backpress\|throttl"
kubectl -n inference describe hpa inference-router

# workers (ssh into GPU hosts)
ssh ops@gpu-node-3
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv
sudo journalctl -u inference-worker -n 200 | grep -Ei "kvmiss|queue_depth|reconnect"

sri: I'll do the escalation matrix. Will define 0-5m (on-call), 5-20m (infra SRE), 20-60m (platform lead + account manager if customer impact). ETA: 2026-04-07.

ops-bot: linked pm#12456 to this thread (https://github.com/redwood/pm/issues/12456)

alex.m: note from staging: autoscaler hit maxReplicas at 8 during synthetic load. I'll test 16/32. Also recommend adding alert "fallback model active" so we can correlate incidents with cost changes.

jordan: I'll include a small decision tree for "cache stampede vs routing hotshard" and exact log greps for each cause so triage is fast.

sam: I'll prepare short examples of expected outputs for each command and include grep examples for the log strings. Gist will be posted and then merged into runbook.

maria: consolidated owners: alex.m (autoscaler, 2026-04-04), jordan (runbook, 2026-03-31), sri (escalation matrix, 2026-04-07), sam (snippets + examples, 2026-03-30). I will run a 45m sync Friday 15:00 UTC to unblock PRs. Update your PRs before sync.

alex.m: ack, will post perf PR link before sync.

jordan: ack, will add "on-call should run these commands within 5 minutes" to each triage step.

sri: will add phone/SMS pager ordering and primary/secondary contacts in the doc.

maria: recurrence note: third similar outage in 6 months. After fixes we'll add a monthly incident-pattern review checklist to the playbook (owner: platform lead).

ops-bot: reminder set for validation exercises: 2026-04-13T14:00:00Z

maria: after runbook merges we'll run two simulated incidents in staging to validate the steps (validation week 2026-04-13). Volunteers noted above. Closing for now, will create single action-tracker issue linking PRs and schedule.
